scripts.build:binary: bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --no-compile-autoload-bunfig packages/cli/src/main.ts --outfile dist/cmdz && ([ "$(uname -s)" != Darwin ] || codesign --force --sign - dist/cmdz)
scripts.install:local: bun run build:binary && mkdir -p "$HOME/.local/bin" && install -m 755 dist/cmdz "$HOME/.local/bin/cmdz"
scripts.test:binary: bun run build:binary && python3 scripts/standalone-smoke.py dist/cmdz
scripts.test: bun --filter=@cmdz/core run test && bun --filter=@cmdz/tui run test && bun --filter=@cmdz/cli run test
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test
